purpose: Behavioral integration of the M444 Standby LP recovery adapter with the M403/M446 Fire Princess LP-gain adapter in TagDuel 2v2.

upstream.standbyRecovery: M405/M444 — Dancing Fairy and Darklord Marie
upstream.priorPipeline: M448 — Solemn Wishes draw to Fire Princess
upstream.companionPipeline: M449 — battle LP recovery to Fire Princess

cards.name: Fire Princess
cards.sourceEvidence: M403 official card evidence; not newly admitted or certified

contract: A live resolving StandbyFlow task is validated for the exact team, physical active seat and turn.
Dancing Fairy and Darklord Marie resolve against one shared LP snapshot.
The caller atomically commits the combined Standby LP gain.
Fire Princess consumes the positive LP-gain event after that commit.
Fire Princess damage is committed separately to the opposing team's shared LP.
Physical owner seats remain distinct from controller teams.
Standby per-event/per-UID turn ledgers and Fire Princess event ledger remain independent.

groups: Darklord Marie activation UID snapshot to Fire Princess
combined Dancing Fairy and Darklord Marie gain
per-copy Standby source negation within the three-Monster-Zone limit
per-copy Fire Princess negation within the three-Monster-Zone limit

limitations: This verifies the adapter-to-adapter event contract, not central resolver registration or StandbyFlow task scheduling.
The trusted resolver must open the Standby task and persist the Darklord Marie activation UID snapshot.
The test simulates caller atomic LP commits; adapters remain read-only.
No live Discord gateway or production database was exercised.
